question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **Realise.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in the blanks is Realise.
 
• The** Realise **means** ****becoming totally conscious.**
 
• Thus, the correct option is Realise.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​**Comprehends- **It means **understanding.​**
 
• **Acknowledges- **It means **accepting or admitting the existence or truth of something.**
 
• **Contrast- **It means **the quality of being radically different from anything else when placed next to or closely associated with it.**

4b:T
